dedupe_keys.name: air and ground launched explosive weapons affecting health facilities 2016 2020 event data

description: This event list records incidents between 2016 and 2020 in which air-launched or ground-launched explosive weapons damaged or affected health facilities. The producer is the EWIPA Community, which published it on the Humanitarian Data Exchange; each event carries a Safeguarding Health in Conflict Coalition (SHCC) event code. Coverage spans the conflicts of the period, including Syria and Yemen, with about 550 events. Each event carries its coalition event code, month, country, type of location such as a health building, weapon type and perpetrator category, with a metadata sheet explaining the fields. The file is available as a free XLSX download with HXL tags under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike licence. Caveats: the provider states the list is neither representative nor complete, dates are by month, locations are given only by country, and the publisher is inactive. Simulation uses: frequencies of deliberate damage to hospitals for conflict scenarios, testing health system resilience to loss of facilities, and linking attacks to service disruption. Related records: the WHO attacks on health care surveillance (data-ssa-public-health-facilities) and the Syria Ministry of Health hospital status list (data-syria-moh-hospitals-status).
